ops.title: Move Forge-specific identifiers out of long-running into the monorepo's settings
ops.body:
Context: owner on yasyf/cc-skills#6016: "monorepo specific things shouldn't be in cc-skills, they should be in the monorepo settings for long-running, need to make that fix and make sure this mistake doesn't get repeated" (ruling b2dcaba). Team lead ordered: move the existing Forge identifiers out of long-running's lib, hooks, agents and skill text group by group, each a commit, raw push (`git push origin HEAD:main # ccx:raw`) and install, then switch tools/foreign-names from added lines to the whole tree. Report the count remaining after each step. Coordinate by SendMessage with lanes answer-router, report-cut, drive-concurrency, tooling-footprint before touching cli.py, state.py, watch.py; go file by file.

Inventory (2026-11-16, origin/main 2d3762070): 420 lines with the widened patterns in plugins/long-running/tools/foreign-names.patterns (env names added), across lib, hooks, agents, skills, capt-hook/hooks, lane-rules, excluding tests and lib/drive/site/vendor. Count with:
git grep -c -I -P -f plugins/long-running/tools/foreign-names.patterns -- plugins/long-running/lib plugins/long-running/hooks plugins/long-running/agents plugins/long-running/skills plugins/long-running/capt-hook/hooks plugins/long-running/lane-rules ':!plugins/long-running/lib/drive/site/vendor' ':!**/tests/**'

Homes for moved content:
- Prose of the skill pages: a [[page]] table in the repo's .claude/long-running.toml ({page = "<page name>", text = "..."}) that `drive manual <page>` appends to the page (cli.manual), so the coordinator still reads it where it reads the page.
- Rules agents and sessions must hold: [[rule]] tables, which render.rules (every role session) and the job brief's "Repo rules" line already carry.
- Literals the code branches on (state.MONOREPO, GUARDED_OWNER, place.MONOREPO, land.DANGEROUS, land.CI_FILES, land.ENQUEUE, cli.MAC_BOX_BUILDS, bash_guard SANDSQL_NAMESPACES/TEAM_AREA, agents.HANDLER_SKILLS): keys under a [drive] table, read through one accessor; a missing key refuses, never permits. repo_config reads the first bound session's cwd; confirm each consumer's checkout advances (coordinator's checkout lagged at #54522) and how hooks without drive data reach the toml.
- land.DANGEROUS needs a parity proof against state.dangerous's fnmatch globs over real PR file lists (#57072 included) before it is deleted, since watch.release_lines auto-lands on that answer.
- Commands in messages (tools/ci ...): named commands under [drive.commands] filled into the message at its call site.
- His quoted words naming Forge things: cite by answer id or ask main once whether quotes are allowlisted.

Order: commit 0 = accessor + test fixture toml holding today's values (tests/conftest) + every key landed in ONE monorepo PR up front through Trunk; then G1 skill/agent markdown, G2 messages/help/docstrings, G3 branching literals, G4 flip tools/foreign-names to the whole tree (CI job and patterns) once the count is 0.

Pitfalls: other lanes edit cli.py/state.py/watch.py concurrently: message them first, small commits, rebase before each push. Many tests assert message strings: update tests with each group. Never work in a worktree another session uses (watch-posts-live-1115 is shared: an autostash incident on 2026-11-16). Work in ~/repos/claude/worktrees/cc-skills/forge-names-1116.

Verification: CI on main (long-running CI test + foreign-names jobs), the count after each group, installed version greps.
